notes:
Partner capability condition main effect extracted separately from the sex interaction and sex main effect. Replication title and DOI verified against publisher metadata, but accessible material was abstract-only. Publisher full-text route returned 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex supplied no OA full text; targeted repository/preprint searches and author Academia profile supplied no accessible full text. No replication values or narrative verdict were extracted from the abstract.
Source follow-up: Primary source is 2016 online-first copy, numbered pp. 1–15 plus publisher cover. Numerics verified on rendered PDF pp. 9–10. Analyses pool prior Wave 1 with newly collected Wave 2; no independent Wave-2-only statistic substituted. Canonical TXT renders partial eta squared as h2p in audit 1793; PDF confirms the metric.
